latest_release.body:
Spring AI Alibaba 2.1.0.0 brings Spring AI 2.1.0 to ReactAgent, Graph, Studio, and the Alibaba Cloud integrations. The release uses Spring Boot 4.2.0, Spring AI Alibaba Extensions 2.1.0.0, MCP Java SDK 2.2.0, Nacos 3.3.0, and the Nacos MSE extension 1.0.7.

## What's new in Spring AI 2.1.0

- **Decision Models.** `DecisionModel` returns typed yes/no, choice, and score answers with probabilities. OpenAI, Ollama, and System One provide implementations. Spring AI also uses decisions for RAG document filtering and reranking, and for matching queries to tools.
- **Message Parts and OpenAI Responses.** Ordered message parts carry text, media, reasoning, tool calls, and tool results with provider payloads. Indexed argument deltas can be displayed while a tool call is forming. `OpenAiResponsesChatModel` adds the Responses API, including hosted tools and replay of encrypted reasoning. Select it with `spring.ai.openai.chat.api=responses`.
- **Session API.** Session Memory records messages and tool exchanges in an event log. It supports turn-aware compaction, keyword recall through `conversation_search`, and a JDBC session repository. Spring AI deprecates `ChatMemory` and its repository APIs in favor of Session Memory.
- **Tool confirmation, limits, and refusal handling.** Tool metadata or a policy can pause a batch for approval. Spring AI adds per-turn call limits, normalized `FinishReasonCategory` values, and typed guardrail refusals that structured-output validation and semantic caching can recognize.
- **Modern MCP.** Stateless MCP 2026-07-28 clients and servers support synchronous and asynchronous APIs alongside existing transports. The revision adds client scoping, tool-change subscriptions, and multi-round requests for client input.
- **Model integrations.** Anthropic moves to Java SDK 3.x, Google GenAI adds image generation and speech APIs, and DeepSeek exposes thinking and reasoning-effort options.
- **Vector stores, documents, and observability.** Eleven upstream vector stores accept user-supplied embeddings for writes and queries. Document processing adds optional token overlap and PDF page ranges. Metrics coverage expands to decision, speech, transcription, and image models. The upstream GA includes 13 CVE fixes.

[Spring AI 2.1.0 GA announcement](https://spring.io/blog/2026/11/20/spring-ai-2-1-0-GA-available-now/) · [Upstream release notes](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-ai/releases/tag/v2.1.0)

## Spring AI Alibaba Agent, Graph, and Studio

- **Request-scoped tool execution.** ReactAgent dispatches tools from the final request after ChatClient advisors run. An explicitly empty selection disables tools for that request. Unavailable calls return typed error results.
- **Approval and checkpoint resume.** Graph supports tool confirmation metadata and explicit human-in-the-loop rules. A batch can contain approved, edited, and rejected calls. Decisions remain separate when providers omit or repeat call IDs, and registered callbacks are checked again on resume.
- **Per-turn dispatch limits.** ReactAgent defaults to 40 calls per tool and 150 total calls per turn across sequential and parallel dispatch. Set both with `ReactAgent.builder().toolCallLimits(perTool, total)`. Rejected and unavailable calls do not consume the budget.
- **Message Parts round trip.** Graph streaming aggregation, checkpoints, and Studio message DTOs carry ordered parts, reasoning, attachments, opaque provider payloads, and tool-result errors. PII redaction and context editing preserve unaffected parts. Legacy checkpoint messages remain readable.
- **Streaming and filtering.** Graph retains the provider's raw finish reason, its normalized category, and final token usage. Filtered replies skip tool dispatch, and routing propagates content filtering without retrying it as a structured-output parsing error.

# [Spring AI Alibaba](https://java2ai.com) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202-4EB1BA.svg)](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html) [![CI Status](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml) [![Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/maven-central/v/com.alibaba.cloud.ai/spring-ai-alibaba-bom?label=Maven%20Central)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/com.alibaba.cloud.ai/spring-ai-alibaba-bom) [![gitleaks badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/protected%20by-gitleaks-blue)](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks)

A production-ready framework for building Agentic, Workflow, and Multi-agent applications.

Getting Started, Graph Docs, Spring AI, Examples.

## Spring AI Alibaba 2.1.0.0 This release uses Spring AI 2.1.0, Spring Boot 4.2.0, Spring AI Alibaba Extensions 2.1.0.0, MCP Java SDK 2.2.0, and Nacos 3.3.0. [Release notes](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/releases/tag/v2.1.0.0) - ReactAgent checks tool calls against the final request and supports human approval, edited arguments, and checkpoint resume. The default per-turn limits are 40 calls per tool and 150 calls across all tools. - Graph and Studio preserve ordered Message Parts, including reasoning, media, and tool results. The workflow LLM node can use Spring AI Session Memory, and the question classifier can use `DecisionModel` for typed routing decisions. - The workflow MCP node and Nacos gateway support Modern MCP (2026-07-28), Streamable HTTP, and SSE. - Extensions update Bailian chat, image, video, audio, and workspace RAG integrations. AnalyticDB, OceanBase, Alibaba OpenSearch, Tablestore, and Tair support writes and searches with precomputed vectors. [Extensions release notes](https://github.com/spring-ai-alibaba/spring-ai-extensions/releases/tag/v2.1.0.0) - Spring AI 2.1 also adds OpenAI Responses API support, turn-aware session compaction and recall, and normalized model finish reasons. [Spring AI 2.1.0 announcement](https://spring.io/blog/2026/11/20/spring-ai-2-1-0-GA-available-now/) ## Architecture

**Spring AI Alibaba Admin** is a one-stop Agent platform that supports visualized Agent development, observability, evaluation, and MCP management, etc. It also integrates with open-source low-code platforms like Dify, enabling rapid migration from DSL to Spring AI Alibaba project. **Spring AI Alibaba Agent Framework** is an agent development framework that can quickly develop agents with built-in **Context Engineering** and **Human In The Loop** support. For scenarios requiring more complex process control, Agent Framework offers built-in workflows like `SequentialAgent`, `ParallelAgent`, `RoutingAgent`, `LoopAgent`. **Spring AI Alibaba Graph** serves as the underlying runtime of the Agent Framework, providing essential capabilities such as persistence, workflow orchestration, and streaming required for long-running stateful agents. Compared to the Agent Framework, users can build more flexible multi-agent workflows based on the Graph API. ## Core Features * **[Multi-Agent Orchestration](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/tree/main/examples/multiagent-patterns)**: Compose multiple agents with built-in patterns including `SequentialAgent`, `ParallelAgent`, `RoutingAgent`, and `LoopAgent` for complex task execution. * **[Multimodal Support](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/tree/main/examples/multimodal)**: ReactAgent with text and media input (image understanding). ReactAgent with tool based image or audio generation. * **[Voice Agent](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/tree/main/examples/voice-agent)**: WebSocket-based real-time voice agent that supports streaming audio or text input and responds with generated audio. * **[Context Engineering](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/agent-framework/tutorials/hooks)**: Built-in best practices for context engineering policies to improve agent reliability and performance, including human-in-the-loop, context compaction, context editing, model & tool call limit, tool retry, planning, dynamic tool selection. * **[Graph-based Workflow](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/graph-core/quick-start)**: Graph based workflow runtime and api for conditional routing, nested graphs, parallel execution, and state management. Export workflows to PlantUML and Mermaid formats. * **[Graph Engineering](./docs/graph-engineering.md)**: Compose specialized agents or deterministic steps into explicit nodes, edges, shared state, verifier nodes, and distributed A2A handoffs when a single `ReactAgent` loop is no longer enough. * **[A2A Support](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/agent-framework/advanced/a2a)**: Agent-to-Agent communication support with Nacos integration, enabling distributed agent coordination and collaboration across services. * **[Rich Model, Tool and MCP Support](https://java2ai.com/integration/chatmodels/dashScope)**: Leveraging core concepts of Spring AI, supports multiple LLM providers (DashScope, OpenAI, etc.), tool calling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). * **[One-stop Agent Platform](https://java2ai.com/ecosystem/admin/quick-start)**: Build agent in a visualized way, deploy agent without code or export as a standalone java project.

## Getting Started ### Run the Chatbot Use JDK 17 or later and a DashScope API key. The repository includes the Maven Wrapper. [Get a Bailian API key](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?apiKey=1&tab=api#/api) ```shell git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba.git cd spring-ai-alibaba export AI_DASHSCOPE_API_KEY=your-api-key ./mvnw -f examples/chatbot/pom.xml spring-boot:run ``` Open the embedded Chat UI once the application starts. [Chatbot UI](http://localhost:8080/chatui/index.html)

### Add Spring AI Alibaba to Your Project Use Spring Boot 4.2.0 and import these BOMs. Add the Agent Framework and DashScope starter dependencies to build a ReactAgent with a DashScope chat model. [Chatbot example POM](./examples/chatbot/pom.xml) ```xml org.springframework.ai spring-ai-bom 2.1.0 pom import com.alibaba.cloud.ai spring-ai-alibaba-extensions-bom 2.1.0.0 pom import com.alibaba.cloud.ai spring-ai-alibaba-bom 2.1.0.0 pom import com.alibaba.cloud.ai spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework com.alibaba.cloud.ai spring-ai-alibaba-starter-dashscope ``` The runnable example also includes Studio to serve the embedded Chat UI. [Chatbot agent source](./examples/chatbot/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/examples/chatbot/ChatbotAgent.java) · [Studio setup](./spring-ai-alibaba-studio/README.md) ## 📚 Documentation * [Overview](https://java2ai.com/docs/overview) - High level overview of the framework * [2.1.0.0 Getting Started](#getting-started) - Run the Chatbot or add the Maven dependencies * [Agent Framework Tutorials](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/agent-framework/tutorials/agents) - Step by step tutorials * [Graph Core Quick Start](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/graph-core/quick-start/) - Build a stateful workflow with the Graph API * [Graph Engineering with Spring AI Alibaba](./docs/graph-engineering.md) - Positioning guide for nodes, edges, shared state, verifier nodes, A2A, and external-agent orchestration * [Lightweight RepoOps Graph Engineering](./docs/graph-engineering-repoops-lightweight.md) - Single-application RepoOps lifecycle design using Spring AI Alibaba Graph, local agents, tools, and optional A2A * [Graph Engineering Examples](./examples/graphengineering) - Runnable RepoOps issue workflow using Spring AI Alibaba Graph with AgentScope Java nodes * [Spring AI Concepts](https://docs.spring.io/spring-ai/reference/concepts.html) - Models, prompts, embeddings, RAG, and tool calling * [Session Memory migration](https://docs.spring.io/spring-ai/reference/2.1-SNAPSHOT/upgrading/session-memory.html) - Move from `ChatMemory` to Spring AI Session Memory ## Project Structure This project consists of several core components: * spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework: A multi-agent framework designed for building intelligent agents with built-in context engineering best practices. * spring-ai-alibaba-graph-core — The graph runtime for checkpointing, streaming, and stateful workflows. Use it directly for custom control flow. * spring-ai-alibaba-admin: A one-stop Agent platform that supports visualized Agent development, observability, evaluation, and MCP management, etc. * spring-ai-alibaba-studio: The embedded ui for quickly debugging agent in a visualized way. * spring-boot-starters: Starters integrating Agent Framework with Nacos to provide A2A and dynamic config features. * examples/graphengineering: Runnable Graph Engineering examples. The current RepoOps issue workflow shows how Spring AI Alibaba Graph owns state and routing while AgentScope Java implements specialist nodes. ## Spring AI Alibaba Ecosystem Repository | Description |
